messages:
zoe: New Optimize launch draft in drive. Need quick decisions: primary CTA (webinar vs demo video), gated PDF in sidebar, and HubSpot wiring. Can we fast-pass? :eyes:

sam: My vote: hero -> short demo video (low friction), sidebar -> gated benchmark PDF for intent capture. We'll A/B the hero copy.

maria: Legal flag: current hero says 'we cut costs 50% for all customers' 1 no. Change to: 'in our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 48%.' Appendix must include model, seq len, GPU, and raw numbers. I'll quick-pass once appendix is attached.

nora: Design: two hero comps ready (video-first / stat-first). Need final hero sentence + exact CTA copy. Also will export 15s and 30s snackables with burned captions once copy locks.

zoe: Updated hero to Maria's wording and added appendix stub. Hero CTA text options: A) "Watch 90s demo" B) "Register for webinar". Sidebar button: "Download full benchmark". Thoughts?

sam: Use "Watch 90s demo" as primary, but include a subtle secondary outline button for the download. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content={video90|pdf_full}.

ops-bot: Ops checklist created: 1) CDN path for PDF/video 2) HubSpot forms/workflows staged 3) hidden fields campaign_id=optimize_launch_2026 & source_detail set. Workflows staged and paused.

maria: Approving wording pending appendix details. Reminder: appendix must include reproducibility notes and config versions.

nora: Uploaded rough MP4s to /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/videos/ and PDF draft to /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/pdfs/. Will replace with final exports after copy lock.

content-bot: Publish preflight checklist: hero image, final copy, legal signoff, CDN assets, HubSpot workflow active, social variants.

zoe: Plan to publish Thu 09:00 PT if legal signs off by EOD tomorrow. If no objections I will schedule and tell ops to unpause workflows at publish. :calendar:
